stem: A Massachusetts-licensed pharmacy technician who is not a trainee works under pharmacist supervision at an eligible hospital ADD. Which scenarios are allowed under the technician stocking policy? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Load pharmacist-verified alprazolam using electronic validation
Remove expired pharmacist-controlled gabapentin stock using electronic validation
Remove expired pharmacist-verified methylphenidate stock using the required electronic validation process.
Load warfarin at an unaffiliated clinic with no on-site pharmacy by relying only on the technician license
Load pharmacist-verified methylphenidate using electronic validation

explanation.core_reasoning: A licensed non-trainee technician may handle pharmacist-verified Schedule II-VI ADD stock under supervision, but not bypass verification or facility prerequisites.

choice_analysis.A: Schedule IV falls within the allowed range.
choice_analysis.C: A licensed non-trainee technician may perform verified Schedule II-VI expired-stock removal with electronic validation.
choice_analysis.E: Licensed non-PTT technicians may stock verified S-II-VI.

related_facts: Electronic validation is part of the permitted stocking/removal workflow.
explanation.mpje_trap: Believing the broader schedule range also removes pharmacist verification.

reasoning_steps: Identify licensed-technician rather than PTT status
